prior_threads.reason: Uriah plans to copy the map, Father William added the witch's home and the Barrow Mound to it, and the party plans to check a marked spot on the way. The treasure is still unfound and the original marks are still unidentified.

The Clurichen, Naggeneen, was caught and is now held in a bag behind Quinn's bar (beat_26, beat_29, beat_40), so the nightly roaming danger has changed in nature. He is captive rather than destroyed, and his offers of a pot of gold, a secret and good luck remain open.

George revealed the lair's location and that the dragon will soon fly (beat_69). The party learned its poison, sulfur breath and impenetrable scales, that it can only be killed with Brandon's sword (beat_61), and that Eric may not have the bounty (beat_71).
Not touched this Session; Lady Hilda was only seen at the tavern.
Shipments still have not arrived, and the cause remains unknown.
Not touched this Session; the challenge stands unaccepted.
Not touched this Session; Ned was only seen at the tavern.
Dunk offered 20 gold for the mule. Gill will only lower his price once his sons return, so the purchase is still pending.

Dunk confirmed the mithril shirt is magical and now aims to get it (beat_47). Ingrid's secret nightly visits (beat_33) partly answer what Warwick is warding against. Why he won't sell the shirt is still unknown.
The ale thief was revealed to be Naggeneen (beat_27). Sir Phidipaldi's help was delivered and Quinn paid the party (beat_29), so nothing is owed or unknown.

new_threads.name: Squints and Trout's Halfling Corps
new_threads.reason: Trout recruited Squints under set terms, including second pick of treasure after the elite members (beat_43), and gave him Brother Dirk as a follower (beat_93). Those terms and the party's secret plan not to rescue him keep the arrangement open.

new_threads.name: Dunk's sleeping-potion deal with Ingrid
new_threads.reason: This is Dunk's stated plan to get Warwick's armor (beat_47). He agreed to help Ingrid dose Warwick and has delivered diluted faun wine (beat_81). The potion, the night meeting and Ingrid's feeling that she owes him are still pending.

new_threads.name: Sir Brandon's sword in the Barrow Mound
new_threads.reason: Father William says the dragon cannot be killed without the sword buried with Brandon (beat_61), so retrieving it serves the dragon hunt. The party is now heading to the Barrow, and Brother Dirk is with them.

new_threads.name: Uriah's penance pledge to Father William
new_threads.reason: Uriah promised Father William penance at the Barrow Mound and a 10 gold donation for its upkeep. This promise to a separate counterpart has not yet been fulfilled.

new_threads.name: Fairies coming out of hiding
new_threads.reason: Ingrid reports that fairies which used to stay hidden are encroaching more often. This is a question or danger that stands apart from the existing threads.

new_threads.name: The man-eating giant in the north woods
new_threads.reason: The party took Brother Dirk from the giant who meant to eat him and outran it. Escaping does not end the danger of a giant living on the route north.
